comment: The four components are well articulated and listed out for tracking progress and making a case. However looking at it from a sustainable financing perpespective - it would be great to have a measure on finance. The hypotheses is that with a DPI approach there would be cost efficiencies - unit cost falls as components are shared. This is particularly compelling as we make a case to a Ministry of Finance (MoF) to argue for investment in this approach

public.text: The four components are well articulated and listed out for tracking progress and making a case. However looking at it from a sustainable financing perpespective - it would be great to have a measure on finance. The hypotheses is that with a DPI approach there would be cost efficiencies - unit cost falls as components are shared. This is particularly compelling as we make a case to a Ministry of Finance (MoF) to argue for investment in this approach
public.suggestedRevision: Add a fifth dimension covering cost and financing: annual running cost of shared components, the share funded from the domestic recurrent budget, and the number of systems retired or consolidated.
